info.name: Plerion API Documentation Alerts Assets API

params.name: ids
params.description: Filter assets based on Asset IDs. Accepts a comma-separated list.

params.name: executionIds
params.description: Filter assets based on Integration Execution IDs. Accepts a comma-separated list.

params.name: regions
params.description: Filter assets based on Provider regions. Accepts a comma-separated list of regions.

params.name: integrationIds
params.description: Filter assets based on Plerion Integration IDs. Accepts a comma-separated list.

params.name: assetGroupIds
params.description: Filter assets based on asset group ids. Accepts a comma-separated list of asset group ids.

params.name: environmentIds
params.description:
Filter assets based on environment IDs. This parameter accepts both environment IDs (UUIDs) and environment names.

**Supported environment names:**
- `production` - Production environment
- `non-production` - Non-production environment

You can provide either environment IDs, environment names, or a combination of both.

params.name: severityLevels
params.description: Filter assets based on vulnerability severity levels. Accepts a comma-separated list of severity levels.

params.name: secretsLevels
params.description: Filter assets based on exposed secrets severity levels. Accepts a comma-separated list of severity levels.

params.name: resourceTypes
params.description: Filter assets based on provider resource types. Accepts a comma-separated list of resource types.

params.name: providers
params.description: Filter assets based on provider. Accepts a comma-separated list of providers.

params.name: services
params.description: Filter assets based on cloud provider services. Accepts a comma-separated list of service names. Each service can be specified either by its name alone (e.g., `S3`, `Lambda`, `EC2`) or prefixed with its provider in the format `Provider::Service` (e.g., `AWS::S3`, `GCP::Compute`, `Azure::VirtualMachine`).

params.name: firstObservedAtStart
params.description:
Start of the date range for filtering assets based on the first observed time. 
Specify the start of the range using a valid ISO 8601 date-time string. 
If `firstObservedAtStart` is provided and `firstObservedAtEnd` is omitted, 
results will include assets from this date to the present.
Supported formats include:
- `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` (e.g., `2020-12-18T08:00:00Z`)
- `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ` (e.g., `2020-12-18T08:00:00.000Z`)

params.name: firstObservedAtEnd
params.description:
End of the date range for filtering assets based on the first observed time. 
Specify the end of the range using a valid ISO 8601 date-time string. 
If `firstObservedAtEnd` is provided and `firstObservedAtStart` is omitted, 
results will include assets up to this date.
Supported formats include:
- `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` (e.g., `2020-12-18T08:00:00Z`)
- `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ` (e.g., `2020-12-18T08:00:00.000Z`)

params.name: hasAdminPrivileges
params.description: Filter assets based on whether the asset has Admin Privileges. The supported values are `true` or `false`

params.name: hasOverlyPermissivePrivileges
params.description: Filter assets based on whether the asset has Overly Permissive Privileges. The supported values are `true` or `false`

params.name: isSusceptibleToPrivilegeEscalation
params.description: Filter assets based on whether the asset is susceptible to privilege escalation. The supported values are `true` or `false`

params.name: hasKev
params.description: Filter assets based on whether the asset has any unresolved vulnerability that is found on the CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog. The supported values are `true` or `false`

params.name: hasExploit
params.description: Filter assets based on whether the asset has any unresolved vulnerability that is referenced on the MITRE Exploit-DB reference map. The supported values are `true` or `false`

params.name: isExploitable
params.description: Filter assets based on whether the asset has any unresolved vulnerability that has a CVSS v3 exploitability score greater than 1. The supported values are `true` or `false`

params.name: isPubliclyExposed
params.description: Filter assets based on whether the asset is Publicly Accessible. The supported values are `true` or `false`

params.name: isVulnerable
params.description: Filter assets based on whether the asset has any unresolved vulnerability regardless of severity, source, or status. The supported values are `true` or `false`

params.name: query
params.description: Filter assets based on the Asset's name matching the provided value

params.name: metadata
params.description: Filter assets based on the asset's metadata matching the provided value. The search performs a case-insensitive substring match against all metadata keys and values, including nested fields.

params.name: riskScoreGte
params.description: Filter assets based on the risk score calculated by Plerion for the asset. The supported values are numbers from 0 to 10.

params.name: operationalStates
params.description:
Filter assets based on their operational state. Accepts a comma-separated list of operational states.

Supported values:
  - `active` — running workloads
  - `inactive` — not running workloads

Supported resource types:
  - AWS EC2 Instance — `active` indicates the instance is in a `running` state; `inactive` indicates it is `stopped` or `terminated`.

When this filter is applied, only assets belonging to resource types that support operational state are returned.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: Order the list by supported field

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order of the list. The parameter sortBy has to be provided to use sortOrder. If sortOrder is not provided the default order is `ASC`

params.name: page
params.description: Get the next batch of assets. Used for pagination

params.name: perPage
params.description: Specify the batch size of the list. Used for pagination

items.docs: Use the list assets API to filter assets across the tenant with many options from Provider, Service, Severity, Integration, etc. By default all assets are returned.

params.name: assetId
params.description: The PRN (asset ID) to retrieve

params.name: include
params.description: Comma-separated list of additional data to include in the response. Use 'rawData' to include the raw asset data.

items.docs: Retrieve a specific asset by its ID within a tenant. This endpoint allows you to get detailed information about a particular asset, including optional raw data if requested.

params.name: assetId
params.description: The asset ID to retrieve the SBOM for

items.docs: Retrieve the Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) for a specific asset identified by its ID within a tenant. This endpoint returns a URL that allows you to download the SBOM file.
